messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: suggestion for improving make help
parts:
I should add that the new test I added somehow got moved
after the pull into

src/test/unit-agrad-fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply_test.cpp

I struggled to understand "make help", but there weren't any
instructions on how to run a single unit test. Eventually
I figured out that I needed to remove the src and give the new
path to the test:

$ mk test/unit-agrad-fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply

and then run it on its own, because the above just makes it

$ ./test/unit-agrad-fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply

I'd specifically suggest replacing these instructions

Tests (requires make 3.81 or higher):
- test-headers : Compiles a trivial file after including each
header separately
- For any subdirectory directory in *src/test*, all tests within
the specified directory and subdirectories can be compiled
and executed by using the folder as the target (without a trailing slash).
Examples:
* all unit tests: src/test/unit
* unit tests for meta: src/test/unit/meta
* normal distribution tests: src/test/unit-distribution/univariate/continuous/normal
- test-all : Runs all tests.

with

TESTS (requires make 3.81 or higher)

All Tests
- test-all

Header Tests
- test-headers

Unit Tests
The unit tests are broken into three targets:
- src/test/unit
- src/test/unit-agrad-rev
- src/test/unit-agrad-fwd

Subdirectory of Unit Tests
For example, to run the unit tests under meta
- src/test/unit/meta

Single Unit Test
For example, to run the diag_post_multiply test, make the target
- test/unit-agrad-fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply
Then run the test outside of make by executing
./test/unit-agrad-fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply


It would be nice if there was an easier way to run a single unit test directly
from make. It's awkward having to enter two commands and I do this all the time
That is, I don't want to have to run all the matrix forward tests when I'm just
working on one of them.

- Bob
